Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that reputable sources (including NPR) cited acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) as Peter Matthiessen’s cause of death. The NPR pieces shown by WebSurfer clearly state acute myeloid leukemia (AML), while other sources say simply “leukemia.” This misreading introduced a wrong subtype and unnecessary inconsistency when the task only required “leukemia.”
